notes.title: b20s: Japanese Translation, Rebalances and more
notes.content:
[h1]Translation Support[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45472510/f656d2e68ed6f54f713a5c0d84e29a5145258833.png[/img]

I’ve spent the last weeks making Gloamvault fully translatable. Due to the high level of interest from Japan, I wanted to complete this as soon as possible. Thanks to the help of two amazing community members Arkblade and Yuzchastics, who provided valuable feedback on the translation system and created a full Japanese translation, the game is now available in its first language besides English.

A big thanks again to the Japanese community for being so enthusiastic about the game!

If you're interested in translating Gloamvault into your language, feel free to drop by the Discord!

[h1]Re-Balances[/h1]

Gloamvault is now generally more challenging. Various advantageous mechanics have been balanced, thereby laying the foundation for a rework of existing systems and the addition of more content in the future. At the same time, monsters can now be charmed at a much better rate. The deeper you go, however, the more you will have to weaken them.

- Enemy-summoned monsters are now uncharmable
- Disabled the "summon to army" item effect
- HP potion drop, extra turn, and shield-on-turn item effects no longer stack
- Slightly reduced merge efficiency
- Stun is now capped at 20%, scales less with stats and duration capped at 2 turns
- Block and Dodge are capped at 70%
- New scoring equation: +1 points for each unique monster encountered, +10 points for each unique monster charmed, +10 points for each level reached, and +1 point for each charmed monster, even if previously charmed
- NPC prices now scale with dungeon depth
- New charm chance equation to replace charm penalty (charm upgrade and item effects disabled for now)
- Damage reduction upgrade nerfed to give 1 reduction per 2 points spent

[u][b]To keep it fair the leaderboard will be reset![/b][/u]

[h1]QoL[/h1]

- Improved formatting for large numbers (e.g., 100k instead of 100.000)
- Increased the game's base window size and font size in several areas

[h1]Misc[/h1]

- Fixed rendering glitch when multiple sprites are close together
- Removed riddle doors to simplify translation, as they didn’t add much to gameplay

notes.title: b19_3: Balance Update + Smaller Fixes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] "Enemies start with -x% HP" no longer stacks. Only the highest effect is applied, up to a maximum of -25%. It won't trigger again after fleeing.
[*] Charm chance is now capped at a maximum of 75%.
[*] Increased charm penalty buildup after level 3.
[*] Increased chance for bosses to block doors.
[*] Slightly nerfed healing (reduced gain from merging, slightly lower base values, and a smaller increase from stats).
[*] Slightly increased enemy power level scaling.
[*] Limited dropped items to a maximum of 3 effects, down from 5.
[*] Lowered percentage value caps on ability-related item effects (reduced to 25% max, down from 85%).
[*] Fixed an issue with the Merge-O-Mat and Meat Grinder consuming side slots, now capped at a 40% chance.
[*] Fixed a crash related to the Tinkerer.
[*] Fixed upgrade point notification appearing unnecessarily.
[*] Added a "Disable audio when window is in background" setting, for everyone playing at work.
[/list]
